description: This file implements a PresenceManager for tracking node presence via heartbeats, managing leases, recovering state from database, and marking nodes inactive upon expiration.

classes.name: PresenceManager
classes.description: Manages node presence status, leases, and expiration handling.

methods.name: NewPresenceManager
methods.description: Constructor for PresenceManager, initializes default TTLs if not set.

methods.name: Touch
methods.description: Updates the last seen time for a node.

methods.name: HasLease
methods.description: Checks if a node has an active lease.

methods.name: SetExpireCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be called on lease expiration.

methods.name: RecoverFromDatabase
methods.description: Recovers node presence state from persistent storage.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main loop for periodic expiration checks.

methods.name: checkExpirations
methods.description: Checks and marks nodes as inactive if their lease has expired.

methods.name: markInactive
methods.description: Marks a node as inactive and triggers callback.
